# Enrollners

> Enrollners is an education marketing agency based in Karachi, Pakistan. It helps private schools, coaching centres (MDCAT, ECAT, CSS, Matric), private colleges (FSc, ICS, I.Com, degree) and training institutes (English, IT, short courses) get more admissions through Meta and Google ads, WhatsApp automation, admission CRMs and school software, and photography and videography. One team handles the whole admissions funnel, from the first click to the first class, and reports cost per enrolled student every month.

Website: https://enrollners.com/
Email: contact@enrollners.com
Serves: institutions anywhere in Pakistan (Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Hyderabad and other cities), plus schools and institutes in the US and UK. Everything runs online.

## Services

- **Admission marketing**: Meta (Facebook, Instagram) and Google admission campaigns planned around each institute's intake calendar, a landing page per programme and intake, social media content, and monthly cost-per-enrolment reports.
- **WhatsApp automation**: instant WhatsApp replies with fees and timings, lead routing to the right counsellor, demo-class and fee reminders, follow-up sequences, and automated daily and monthly reports.
- **Software solutions**: custom admission CRMs, student, fee and attendance management, multi-branch accounting systems, websites and student portals.
- **Photography and videography**: campus and classroom photo shoots, campus tours and prospectus videos, student stories (with consent), and reels and video ads.
- **Free admissions audit**: a 20-minute review of an institute's current ads, landing page and reply speed, plus what competitors in its city are running, with three fixes it can apply that week, whether or not it hires Enrollners.

## Standards on every account

- First reply to every new inquiry on WhatsApp in under 5 minutes.
- 100% of inquiries tracked from first click to enrolment.
- New creative and budget changes every week, based on admissions.
- A monthly report showing cost per enrolled student.

## Results from real campaigns (Meta Ads Manager)

- 8,428 student WhatsApp and Messenger conversations at about Rs 20 (US$0.07) each, about Rs 1.68 lac in spend. Meta rated this cost 68% lower than similar advertisers (median about Rs 45).
- A Pakistan WhatsApp campaign: 1,068 conversations at Rs 15 each, Rs 16,057 spent.
- A lead-form campaign: 133 form leads at about Rs 3,400 (GBP 9.17) per lead.
Dollar and pound figures are converted at about Rs 280 per US$ and Rs 370 per GBP (October 2026).

## Frequently asked questions

**What does an education marketing agency do?**
It helps schools, coaching centres, colleges and training institutes attract and enrol students: admission campaigns on Meta and Google, fast WhatsApp replies, CRM tracking of every lead, and reporting on cost per enrolled student.

**How can a private school in Pakistan get more admissions?**
Start before admission season (February to April for most private schools), show parents what they worry about (safety, teachers, results and fees), make campus visits easy to book online, reply on WhatsApp within minutes, and follow up every inquiry until the form is in.

**How much should a school or academy spend on Facebook and Instagram ads?**
Fee × share of leads who enrol × share of the fee you are happy to spend = the most you can pay per lead. Example: Rs 60,000 fee, 1 in 10 leads enrols, 10% of the fee → up to Rs 600 per lead. Start small and scale what brings admissions.

**What is a good cost per lead for education ads in Pakistan?**
It depends on the fee and conversion rate. In Enrollners' campaigns, WhatsApp conversations cost about Rs 15–20 each and lead forms for a higher-fee programme about Rs 3,400 per lead. Judge campaigns by cost per enrolled student.

**How fast should an institute reply to an inquiry?**
Within five minutes. Students usually message three or four institutes and join the one that answers well first.

**Does Enrollners only work with educational institutes?**
Yes: private schools, coaching centres, private colleges and training institutes.
